scope.summary: Phase-ordered implementation of Phase 0 diagnostics and governance, Phase 1 KIS 1.0 runtime/customization/template foundations, and Phase 2 Business Definitions and Schema Plans reference migrations.
scope.excluded_worktree_note: Accepted merged master tree only; no Phase 3-6 working-tree changes are included.

routes: Core graphical route registrations are source-bound as exact name, path, and method tuples; KIS surface and navigation bindings are explicit while legacy surfaces remain declared as legacy.
capabilities: Typed surface capabilities and navigation capability bindings are checked against the programme inventory; runtime authorization remains the application-service boundary.
fields: Business Definition fields use a focused, collapsible editor without removing source-bound field payload evidence; presentation preferences persist through typed, versioned scope records.
actions: Business Definition and Schema Plan actions are reorganized into task-focused KIS workspaces with bounded URL tabs, preserved redirects, confirmations, and no-JavaScript form behavior.
payloads: The Phase 2 parity manifest binds route, capability, field, action, payload, validation, error, and outcome evidence to production source; its dependency-free verifier passes.
states: Guest/authenticated, empty/sparse/dense/error, permission-reduced/read-only, dirty/conflict, approval/execution/recovery, no-JavaScript, mobile, and installable-template states are represented in contracts or focused tests.
behavior_changes.notes: Merged PR #30 was stakeholder-accepted after the canonical PHP quality, frontend, browser, database, security, Compose, artifact-install, deployment, and recovery workflows all passed on its byte-identical source tree.

parity.result_summary: The Phase 2 parity verifier, application tests, 68-case Chromium suite, three supported database jobs, deployment acceptance, security, and recovery evidence passed on the PR head whose tree exactly equals merged master commit 3b9a785.

security.summary: Schema Plan and definition publication presentation/request mapping changed; source safeguards and parity bindings exist, while native negative-path runtime evidence remains pending.

accessibility.summary: Semantic KIS primitives, keyboard recovery, no-JavaScript behavior, focus management, and diagnostics are implemented; Chromium-dependent Axe, zoom, touch, and visual evidence remains blocked.

customization.summary: Typed, versioned presentation preferences now persist with precedence, authorization, optimistic versioning, import/export, audit, fallback, and reset boundaries; runtime topology qualification remains pending.

templates.summary: Site and administrator templates declare machine-readable KIS compatibility and pass bounded visible-semantic activation validation while retaining safe markup/theme customization and schema-1 compatibility.

extensions.summary: Typed KIS surface contracts, exact owner namespace admission, collision protection, navigation bindings, schema/runtime parity, and scaffold rules affect extension authors; full install/upgrade/browser qualification remains pending.

database.summary: Portable preferences and interface state passed MariaDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL suites plus clean-target backup/restore.

deployment.summary: Composer/ZIP installation, production images, Compose, trust-boundary, extension lifecycle and recovery acceptance passed.

recovery.strategy: If qualification exposes a regression, revert the affected phase-scoped commits in reverse dependency order while retaining data migrations unless a tested reverse migration exists. Use protected core template fallback, version compatibility rejection, and presentation-preference reset/import recovery rather than bypassing the KIS shell.
recovery.command_or_procedure: Kumwe CI clean-target backup/restore and all three production deployment acceptance variants passed on PR #30.

signoff.notes: PR #30 was merged and the user explicitly directed continuation through Phase 3-6 after all required workflows passed.
